items.title: Awesome Mqtt
items.content_text:
### Brokers

*   [PLCcom MQTT Standalone Broker](https://www.indi-an.com/en/plccom/mqtt/mqtt-standalone-broker/) - Free MQTT broker for Windows. MQTT 3.1.1 and 5.0 over TLS, TCP and WebSocket, several listeners, access control.

### Tools

*   [PLCcom MQTT Client Tool](https://www.indi-an.com/en/plccom/mqtt/mqtt-client-tool/) - Free MQTT client for Windows. MQTT 3.1.1 and 5.0 over TLS, TCP and WebSocket, publish, subscribe and request/response.

### Industry / Firmwares for ESP based Devices

*   [tagbridge (⭐0)](https://github.com/DanShinde/tagbridge) - Config-driven Modbus and OPC UA to MQTT gateway with Sparkplug B and Unified Namespace output.

### Monitoring / Firmwares for ESP based Devices

*   [iotaudit (⭐13)](https://github.com/emirmrkaljevic/iotaudit) - Local CLI that grades your own smart home devices and publishes the results to MQTT with Home Assistant discovery.

### Visualization, Dashboards / Firmwares for ESP based Devices

*   [MQTT Dash 2](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.routix.mqttdash2) - Android app for building dashboards for MQTT smart home devices and applications. Successor of MQTT Dash, by the same developer.
*   [Routix Dash](https://routix-dash.com) - iPhone and iPad app for live dashboards from MQTT brokers, HTTP APIs, WebSocket and Server-Sent Events, with charts, gauges, switches and sliders that publish back.

items.content_text:
### Reading and Writing Tools / Writing

*   [Meboki](https://meboki.com) - Open-source grammar checker that runs a local model on your Mac and fixes text in any app. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/mebokihq/meboki) ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Developer Tools / IDEs

*   [Alook](https://alook.ai/) - Open-source, local-first group chat where people and coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex work together in shared rooms. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/alookai/alook) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### AI Tools / Other Tools

*   [AppuBot](https://appubot.com) - Open-source (Apache 2.0) team of AI bots, each with its own job, that hand tasks to each other and work in your real apps and files, on the Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Grok or Copilot plan you already have. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/sarthakguptadev/AppuBot) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

*   [CutVoke (⭐49)](https://github.com/frankShan001/CutVoke) - Open-source, local-first video editor with a built-in MCP server, so AI agents and you edit the same multi-track timeline. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/frankShan001/CutVoke) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

*   [Relaycat (⭐0)](https://github.com/krutikJain/relaycat) - Runs several Claude desktop accounts, switches between them in one click, brings chats along and shows each account's session and weekly limits. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/krutikJain/relaycat) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")
*   [CablePeek](https://cablepeek.pages.dev) - Shows the USB-C link speed at the screen edge next to the port when you plug in, with eject on hover. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/diegobruegger-prog/cablepeek) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / Productivity

*   [VYSHYVKA BAR](https://sapio-sat.github.io/vyshyvka-bar/) - Open-source Touch Bar replacement with animated Ukrainian embroidery, weather forecast, and system controls. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/sapio-sat/vyshyvka-bar) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Utilities / Window Management

*   [AutoWindow](https://zein.nl/autowindow/) - Open-source menu bar app that restores window layouts per monitor setup and per Mission Control desktop. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/Carpe-Futurum/autowindow) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

items.title: Urban and Regional Planning Resources
items.content_text:
### Public Data Resources / Resilience and Natural Hazards

*   [SHIELDUS](https://cemhs.asu.edu/sheldus) - This is a county-level U.S. database of natural hazard events from 1960 to the present. It covers thunderstorms, hurricanes, floods, wildfires, tornadoes, flash floods and heavy rainfall, and records each event's date, the affected county and state, and its direct losses in property damage, crop damage, injuries and fatalities.

items.title: Awesome Terraform
items.content_text:
### Community

*   [Terraform and OpenTofu Skill for AI Agents (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/antonbabenko/terraform-skill) - Agent skill with Terraform and OpenTofu best practices for testing, module design, CI/CD workflows and production patterns. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Kiro and other Agent Skills-compatible tools.

### Tutorials and Blog Posts / Multi-Environment Configuration

*   [Terraform Design Patterns: the Terrafile](https://web.archive.org/web/20260213070554/https://bensnape.com/2016/01/14/terraform-design-patterns-the-terrafile/) - Managing Terraform modules and their versions within Terraform projects with Terrafile.

### Providers / Vendor supported providers

*   [terraform-provider-aws (compliance.tf) (⭐4)](https://github.com/compliancetf/terraform-provider-aws) - AWS provider for Terraform and OpenTofu by compliance.tf. Runs the unmodified `hashicorp/aws` provider and checks `aws_*` resources against compliance controls before apply. Warns by default; can fail the run in CI.

### Tools / Community providers

*   [ctfkit (⭐4)](https://github.com/compliancetf/ctfkit) - Offline analyzer for Terraform and OpenTofu configuration, plans and module manifests. Writes SARIF findings. Needs no cloud credentials. Also available as a [GitHub Action (⭐2)](https://github.com/compliancetf/ctfkit-action).
*   [modulestf (⭐377)](https://github.com/modulestf/modulestf) - Agent skills for Claude Code and Codex that review, fix and maintain reusable Terraform modules by the rules of terraform-aws-modules. Rules: [modules.tf/rules](https://modules.tf/rules/).
*   [mtf-facts (⭐21)](https://github.com/modulestf/facts) - Offline Go CLI that parses Terraform module trees and reports rule results, findings with evidence, and interface and provider schema diffs. Works as a standalone module linter.
*   [repro-lambda (⭐15)](https://github.com/antonbabenko/repro-lambda) - Builds byte-identical AWS Lambda packages on macOS and Linux, uploads them to S3 by content hash, and passes them to terraform-aws-lambda as `s3_existing_package`, so `terraform plan` builds nothing.
